identifiers.identifier_scope: Investigational autologous GD2-directed CAR T-cell product; no verified standard small-molecule/biologic registry identifiers found.

drug_class: GD2-directed chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapy
modality: Autologous genetically modified T-lymphocyte cellular immunotherapy

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: Autologous T lymphocytes are genetically modified to express a fourth-generation safety-designed chimeric antigen receptor (4SCAR) that recognizes GD2 on tumor cells, leading to antigen-dependent T-cell activation and tumor cell killing.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: Engineered CAR-mediated binding to the disialoganglioside GD2 on tumor cells triggers T-cell activation, cytokine release, proliferation, and cytotoxic killing. The 4SCAR platform is a synthetic receptor design rather than a native ligand-receptor drug interaction.
downstream_effects: In vivo expansion and persistence of CAR T cells
mechanism_of_action.selectivity: Intended to target GD2-expressing malignant cells; GD2 is also expressed on some normal neural-derived tissues, which may contribute to on-target/off-tumor toxicity risk.

typical_use.cancer: GD2-positive solid tumors and central nervous system tumors
typical_use.histology: Includes neuroblastoma and diffuse intrinsic pontine glioma in early clinical investigation

adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Antigen-driven CAR T-cell activation can induce systemic inflammatory cytokine release.
Immune activation and endothelial/inflammatory effects associated with CAR T-cell therapy may contribute to neurologic toxicity.

adverse_effects.effect: On-target/off-tumor toxicity to GD2-expressing normal tissues
adverse_effects.biological_explanation: GD2 expression on some normal tissues, especially neural-derived tissues, creates risk of collateral immune attack.

other_reported_adverse_effects.biological_explanation: Observed toxicities in CAR T-cell treatment programs may derive from conditioning chemotherapy, immune activation, and prolonged cytopenias.

drug_interactions.biological_basis: May reduce CAR T-cell expansion, persistence, and antitumor activity; often used therapeutically to manage toxicity.

data_notes.record_scope: This record summarizes publicly identifiable information for the investigational cellular therapy 4SCAR-GD2-modified T-lymphocytes. Quantitative efficacy and pharmacokinetic fields are left null/empty where specific published human metrics were not verified.
